$comment: See assets/archetypes/booking/decisions.json for what this file is for. Delete it if the target ever states a brand element.

brand.because: The accepted target has no brand element. Its demo's own h1 names the event - 'Future Web 2026', with '24-25 October - Barbican Centre, London' - and for an event-registration site the event is the site's name. The candidate is weak (a heading can be a page title), which is exactly why the choice is recorded here with its evidence rather than extracted silently.
